descriptionEn: An apartment is offered for sale in Prishtina e Re, in the PUHIZA 2 complex, Rruga “Behar Begolli”.

The apartment is located in a sought-after and dynamic area, with easy access to services, business centres, markets and public transport. The practical location is ideal for families or professionals, near QKUK and Rruga A, in a quiet setting with complete infrastructure.

The property has a total area of 134.40m² and includes a living room with kitchen, three bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate WC, two terraces facing two sides of the building and a storage room/additional space. The apartment is designed for comfort and functionality, with abundant natural light and underfloor heating, which offers comfort and thermal efficiency.
This property is suitable for families and offers free-flowing space, as well as easy access to every part of the city.
The price is offered by agreement and the contract is signed at the notary.
